notes: Adventure: going through a dark forest to reach the far side is a traversal journey, and the author ruled out the one reading that would have made it Survival by saying nothing chases you — the goal is simply to arrive. route-guided is the shape because a one-minute walk with a destination is a single directed route through one continuous space, not an open world to wander; Adventure words it as a guided corridor. Guided Trail is the matching preset, but I dropped reveal-exit: it routes P3 for a cave-mouth-style enclosure transition that this prompt never asks for, and a forest edge is not an interior boundary, so the build stays on the proven P0 path. That leaves the trail through the trees and a focal landmark, which is also how the run gets somewhere to end — I sited the landmark at the far side so the exit is visible and pulls the player forward, since layout needs a terminating point even though the win condition itself is not a layout question.
